name: Shiraishi Momoko
source:
A receptionist at Sugimoto Pharmaceuticals.
A devoted girl who will sacrifice herself to heal a man's heart. She
has a strong core and will never give up until the other person is healed.
She treats everyone kindly, so she has many fans both inside and outside the company.
She respects Kisaku... maybe.



[Translated from the [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20040429210739/http://www.elf-game.co.jp/net_shop/soft/special/kisaku/kisaku4.html]game's site, archived[/url]]
